hook: Walking vs Running - which one is better for daily fitness?
caption:
🚶‍♂️ Walking vs Running: Meeku edi manchidi? Daily fitness kosam parugulu pettalanna pani ledu, brisk walk tho kuda chaala health benefits untayi! 🌿

Ee reel niku nachithe mee fitness friends ki share cheyyandi! ✨

#WalkingVsRunning #FitnessTelugu #HealthTipsTelugu #WeightLossJourney #DailyWalk #HeartHealth #TeluguFitness #HealthyLifestyle
poster_caption:
Stop destroying your joints with endless daily running if your goal is sustainable fat loss and metabolic health! 🔥

Here is what science actually shows:
• Walking keeps you in the optimal fat-oxidation zone without spiking stress hormones.
• Excessive running can elevate cortisol, leading to muscle loss and fat retention.
• Running puts 3x your body weight in impact force on your joints every single stride.

📌 Save this guide for your daily health routine!
